title: Negative-index metamaterials
description: Documented public electromagnetic metamaterial (Pendry (theory); Smith et al. (demo, 2000)) for the Metamaterial Architect capability area.
body:
Negative-index metamaterials is a documented electromagnetic metamaterial from Pendry (theory); Smith et al. (demo, 2000). Structures with simultaneously negative permittivity and permeability, demonstrating negative refraction — the founding metamaterial result.

How it works: It works by applying the Maxwell-Garnett mixing formula to host permittivity, inclusion permittivity, and volume fraction.

Documented uses of this capability area include alloy design for aerospace, metamaterial antennas and cloaks, composite airframes, and failure-life prediction for critical structures.
